method.selection: Nearest station with a valid observation for the requested fields, then nearest observation in time. No interpolation. Ocean and land conditions can differ.

sources.name: Iowa Environmental Mesonet ASOS/METAR archive
sources.note: Archived airport observations; routine and special reports, limited quality control.

sources.name: NOAA National Data Buoy Center
sources.note: Archived buoy observations; missing values retained as null. Significant wave height, not maximum individual wave height.
